blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – The Supreme Court has ruled in favor of petitions seeking to compel Congress to pass a law on political dynasties. READ: Marcos bent on approval anti-political dynasty bill before term ends The full court decision penned by Associate Justice Ramon Paul Hernando granted three consolidated petitions in GR numbers 263934, 272370, and 279201 filed by 1Sambayan Coalition—led by retired Supreme Court Associate Justice Antonio Carpio and retired Ombudsman Conchita Carpio Morales—along with groups of legal scholars and civic leaders. The petitions challenged Congress’s prolonged failure to pass a law defining and prohibiting political dynasties. In its ruling, SC […]...
